property_mix.era: mixed Victorian riverside core with extensive post-war suburban expansion
property_mix.notable: Historic town center with Georgian properties; significant modern residential growth. Many older properties retain period locks and mechanisms.

locksmith_relevant: Hartford's riverside Victorian terraces often feature original cast-iron hardware and period locks requiring specialist knowledge and care.
Post-war estates across Sapley, Newtown, and Oxmoor have high volumes of standard cylinder locks and uPVC door seals—common callout areas.
New-build developments in St Johns Park and Stukeley Meadows drive demand for smart lock installation and electronic access system support.
